Name: sqbr's Dialogue Edits
Author: sqbr
Description:
Installation Guide:
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

Configuration:
Either edit config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[list]
[*]﻿Less Ableism with George: George is more at peace with being in a wheelchair, and Penny and Harvey are more respectful. He's still a grump though :)
[*]Shane Can Be Ok: Changes a few lines that show up after his 8 heart event which seemed to contradict him being in a better place: he no longer gets more depressed after Jojamart closes, and doesn't refer to drinking alcohol at the resort.  
[*]Less Controlling Demetrius: Instead of threatening the farmer when they get close to Maru, he instead awkwardly tries to encourage the friendship in a way Maru finds annoying. 
[*]Sebastian and Sam Stay Friends: Changes lines stating or implying that they don't hang out with each other as friends if either of them are married to the Farmer. Sam also doesn't talk about giving up on music.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b]

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13434]Gender Setter[/url]. 

This mod just changes existing dialogue, so shouldn't cause huge issues with other mods. It doesn't match very well with Canon-Friendly Dialogue, and there's too many lines in that I'd need to edit for me to want to add compatibility. It is probably broadly compatible with SVE but I haven't checked.
